text:
Nina: Quick note 1: proposing a cohort-weighted stability gate for the v4p2-quant rollout. idea: score combines MRR delta, KL shift, and a semantic concordance metric, then we multiply by a cohort impact weight.
Raj: sounds sensible. can you write the scoring formula?
Nina: high level:
```
normalized = clip((metric - baseline)/p99, 0, 1)
core_score = 0.45*MRR_drop_norm + 0.3*KL_norm + 0.25*(1 - concordance_norm)
weighted_score = core_score * cohort_weight  # cohort_weight in [0.6,2.0]
if weighted_score >= 0.7 -> autofallback
if 0.5 <= weighted_score < 0.7 for 2 consecutive windows -> pause traffic + notify
```
Eloise: where does hallucination probe fit? we still need a focused small probe for regressions that don't show in MRR.
Nina: good call. put the halluc_probe as an override: if halluc_rate > 0.6% AND concordance_drop > 2.5% -> immediate autofallback. treat as semantic hard-gate.
Ben: how do we pick p99 per-cohort? historical window? rolling 30d?
Raj: propose rolling 14d with a weekly refresh. for very new cohorts use global/default p99 until enough data.
Eloise: volume concerns: KL is noisy on low-volume slices. require min_requests=1k per window or extend window to 5m. also apply variance damping factor = sqrt(min(n,2000)/2000).
CI-bot: canary-run: baseline=v4p1@2026-02-11, candidate=v4p2-quant@2026-03-03, samples=6k, MRR_delta=-0.93%, KL_50=0.078, concordance=93.1%, halluc_probe=0.42%. cohort=payments, cohort_weight=1.6.
Nina: plug-in quick calc: MRR_norm~0.58 (p99~1.6%), KL_norm~0.39 (p99~0.2), (1 - concordance_norm) ~ 0.22 (concordance drop 1.9% with p99 norm denominator 8.5%?) -> core_score~0.45*0.58+0.3*0.39+0.25*0.22 = 0.261+0.117+0.055 = 0.433 -> weighted_score=0.693 -> borderline autofallback.
Raj: borderline indeed. with cohort_weight 1.6 that's risky for payments. maybe restrict weights for regulated cohorts to max 1.4 unless SRE approves.
Eloise: I'd rather tune the weights to protect high-value cohorts (higher weight => stricter). but Raj's proposal reduces volatility for sensitive cohorts. we need product input.
Ben: ops question: alert routing? autofallback should page SRE and create rollback ticket; investigate band should post to #eng-ml with @oncall-sre and product leads.
Nina: agreed. autofallback -> pager + rollback ticket + attach top-50 diffs and sample artifacts. investigate -> slack alert + triage checklist.
ops-bot: note: storage budget for artifacts capped at 10GB/day; please compress logits and store only top-64 tokens.
CI-bot: offline stress: ran 8 sims (10k samples each) across cohorts: payments, legal, chat, docs-long. results: payments: 3/8 runs would have autofallbacked with current weights; legal: 2/8; chat: 0/8; docs-long: 4/8 (high variance). link: https://redwood.internal/sims/4378901234 (private).
Eloise: docs-long volatility is concerning. maybe add a longdoc_adjust factor: reduce KL weight to 0.2 and increase concordance weight to 0.4 for longdocs.
Raj: alternative: keep weights but require 2 consecutive windows for longdocs before autofallback.
Nina: pragmatic: implement both: per-cohort weight table + per-slice overrides (longdocs) + min-window count. will include defaults in RFC.
Ben: can we run a 50k sample end-to-end sim focusing on payments + docs-long to calibrate p99 values and cohort weights?
CI-bot: queued 50k sim, ETA 4h.
Nina: ops: alerting thresholds: autofallback pages SRE immediately; investigate band posts to #eng-ml and tags @oncall-sre and product leads for that cohort. also create ephemeral incident channel when pause is triggered.
ops-bot: ack. I'll prepare the oncall escalation matrix.
Eloise: we'll also want a quick manual-override button in the console for oncall to unpause and continue if root-cause is known.
Nina: added to runbook. next: I'll draft RFC with formulas, cohort_weight defaults, longdoc override, artifact retention plan, and the dashboard widgets (score timeseries, per-slice breakdown). scheduling smoke at 0200 PST tomorrow.
Raj: +1. I'll review and help with cohort defaults.
Ben: thanks all. remind: keep sim outputs and diffs for 30d for audit.
Nina: thanks team 1, will post RFC link when ready.
